parsed.post: Increased depth from 4 to 6 in the latest run. This resulted in a significant improvement, dropping val_bpb from 1.044666 to 1.014553. It seems higher capacity is helping. Next, I'll try increasing the aspect ratio to see if more context/structure improves performance.
parsed.description: Keep depth 6 and increase aspect ratio to 64 to expand model capacity and context window.
